paragraphs.text: Darksteel , the second set in the Mirrodin block , continued the block's focus on artifacts while introducing major mechanics like indestructible and expanding on modular . Alongside the set's release in February 2004, Wizards of the Coast published four preconstructed theme decks designed to showcase its mechanics and flavor. Each of these decks highlighted different strategic angles of the set — from aggressive red burn to black discard, green-white token swarms, and blue artifact synergies.
Master Blaster is a theme deck from Darksteel .
The 2 rares in this deck are Gemini Engine and Pulse of the Forge .
Mind Swarm is a theme deck from Darksteel .
The 2 rares in this deck are Mephitic Ooze and Pulse of the Dross .
Swarm & Slam is a theme deck from Darksteel .
The 2 rares in this deck are Myr Matrix and Pulse of the Tangle .
Transference is a theme deck from Darksteel . Transference contains 4 copies of cards banned in Mirrodin block ; Seat of the Synod and Skullclamp . Skullclamp is also banned in Legacy.
The 2 rares in this deck are Arcbound Reclaimer and Reshape .
